A legendary avian creature with a pale cream plumage and a distinctive pinkish-red floral crest. The eyes are small, dark, and focused. The body is slender and avian with small wings and three-toed talons. The outfit consists of a flowing, cloud-like white base with a large, pink flower-shaped headpiece. It has a long, thin tail ending in a pink heart-shaped bulb.
BODY COLOR: pale cream
